game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Ember Fields Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields, fields of drifting embers: the ember mage must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before molten golems spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields: fields of drifting embers
core_gameplay_loop: In Ember Fields, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before molten golems spring the trap. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the predictions value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about predictions to power up the ember mage and open the lava bridge.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mixed Type Oracle' (Week 2 slot 15), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Ember Fields'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against molten golems in Ember Fields.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
